en-US.title: Agent
en-US.gatewayHint: Use the Gateway HTTPS/WSS base address. Connect binds this device on first use.
en-US.qbHint: Enter the download tool IP or hostname, including a NAS or another device on your network. The port and API path are filled in automatically.
en-US.transmissionHint: Enter the download tool IP or hostname, including a NAS or another device on your network. Port 9091 and the RPC path are filled in automatically.
en-US.keepSecret: Leave blank to keep the saved value
en-US.targetHint: For a different address, download tool, username, or authentication method, enter the required password or API Key.
en-US.invalidUrl: Enter a valid address. Embedded credentials, query strings, and fragments are not allowed.
en-US.invalidSettings: Check the settings and username length.
en-US.invalidSecret: Secret values must be between 1 and 4096 bytes.
en-US.targetChanged: The connection target changed. Enter the credentials required by the new target.
en-US.credentialError: System secure storage is unavailable. Check system access permissions and try again.
en-US.storageError: Could not read or save local settings. Check file permissions and whether settings.json is valid.
en-US.runtimeError: The desktop operation failed. Try again or check the diagnostic log.
en-US.timeout: The connection timed out. Check the address and try again.
en-US.networkError: Could not reach the configured service. Check the address, TLS certificate, and API access.
en-US.authenticationError: The download tool rejected authentication or API access. Check the selected authentication method, credentials, and access rules.
en-US.httpError: The configured service returned an unsuccessful HTTP response or redirect.
en-US.invalidResponse: The configured service returned an invalid API response.
en-US.unknownError: The operation failed. Check the local diagnostic log.
en-US.insecureGateway: Gateway requires HTTPS/WSS. Insecure transport requires explicit development configuration.
en-US.autostartError: Could not update login startup. Check OS permissions and try again.
en-US.invalidCommand: Gateway sent an invalid or expired command.
en-US.gatewayRequired: Enter a Gateway address and API Key before connecting.
en-US.gatewayProtocol: Gateway does not provide the expected client protocol. Check the address and server version.
en-US.legacyIdentity: This device uses an older protocol. Click Connect to migrate its local identity.
en-US.deviceLimitReached: The account has no available device slot. Manage devices in Popular, then connect again.
en-US.gatewayUnavailable: Gateway or its Popular backend is unavailable. The connection will retry.
en-US.gatewayRejected: Gateway rejected the request. Check the diagnostic log for the protocol error.
en-US.sessionRevoked: Connection authorization revoked. Click Connect to verify this device again.
en-US.introduction: Agent connects your local download tools to Popular Movie Center.
en-US.resetHint: Remove the saved download tool address, username and password? Existing downloads and task history will be kept.
en-US.downloaderRequired: Connect a local download tool first.
en-US.gatewayExplanation: Gateway connects Agent to Popular Movie Center to receive download requests and report task status. Your download tool performs the downloads and saves files in its configured folder.
en-US.downloaderExplanation: Keep Agent and your download tool running. If the download tool is stopped, Web access is disabled, or its address, port or access permissions are incorrect, Agent cannot add tasks or retrieve their status.
en-US.webAccessHelp: How do I enable Web access?
en-US.webAccessInstructions: Start your download tool and enable Web UI / remote access in its settings. Then enter its address, port and credentials in Agent. For a NAS, also allow access from the computer running Agent.
en-US.webAccessDocs: For setup instructions, see the official documentation:
en-US.documentationError: Could not open the documentation. Use the link address in your browser.
en-US.queueNotSynced: No queue snapshot yet. Connect Agent to Gateway to load pending tasks.
en-US.queueStale: Cached snapshot. The queue may have changed since the last sync.
en-US.queueEmpty: No pending tasks for this Agent.
en-US.queueLoadError: Could not update the queue. Your last snapshot is retained.
en-US.queueReason_agent_offline: Waiting to retry delivery to Agent
en-US.queueReason_executing: Waiting for the download tool to confirm
en-US.apiKeyHint: Requires qBittorrent 5.2.0 or later. Generate an API Key in qBittorrent Preferences → WebUI → API Key. This is separate from the Gateway Key.
en-US.queueLimitExplanation: {site} reported the daily download limit for this torrent. It has not been submitted to your download tool.
en-US.queueLimitPaused: Automatic retry is paused until the next attempt time (24-hour cooldown).
en-US.queueLimitDue: The cooldown has ended; waiting for Popular to retry.
en-US.queueExpiresBeforeRetry: This task expires before the next attempt.

zh-CN.title: Agent
zh-CN.gatewayHint: 填写 网关 的 HTTPS/WSS 基础地址。首次连接时自动绑定此设备。
zh-CN.qbHint: 填写下载工具的 IP 或主机名，支持 NAS 等内网设备，自动补全端口和接口路径。
zh-CN.transmissionHint: 填写下载工具的 IP 或主机名，支持 NAS 等内网设备，自动补全 9091 端口和 RPC 路径。
zh-CN.targetHint: 更换地址、下载工具、用户名或认证方式后，请输入所需的密码或 API Key。
zh-CN.invalidUrl: 请输入有效地址，不允许内嵌凭据、查询参数或片段。
zh-CN.invalidSettings: 请检查设置和用户名长度。
zh-CN.invalidSecret: 密钥长度须为 1–4096 字节。
zh-CN.targetChanged: 连接目标已改变，请输入新目标所需的凭据。
zh-CN.credentialError: 系统安全存储不可用，请检查系统访问权限后重试。
zh-CN.storageError: 无法读取或保存本机设置。请检查文件权限及 settings.json 是否有效。
zh-CN.runtimeError: 桌面操作失败，请重试或查看诊断日志。
zh-CN.timeout: 连接超时，请检查地址后重试。
zh-CN.networkError: 无法连接所配置的服务，请检查地址、TLS 证书和接口访问。
zh-CN.authenticationError: 下载工具拒绝了认证或 API 访问。请检查所选认证方式、凭据和访问规则。
zh-CN.httpError: 所配置的服务返回异常 HTTP 响应或重定向。
zh-CN.invalidResponse: 所配置的服务返回无效的接口响应。
zh-CN.unknownError: 操作失败，请查看本机诊断日志。
zh-CN.insecureGateway: 网关 必须使用 HTTPS/WSS；明文传输需要显式开发配置。
zh-CN.autostartError: 无法修改登录启动设置，请检查系统权限后重试。
zh-CN.invalidCommand: 网关 命令无效或已过期。
zh-CN.gatewayRequired: 请先填写 网关 地址和 API Key，再连接。
zh-CN.gatewayProtocol: 网关 未提供所需客户端协议，请检查地址和服务端版本。
zh-CN.legacyIdentity: 当前设备使用旧协议，请点击连接迁移本机身份。
zh-CN.deviceLimitReached: 账户没有可用设备名额，请在 Popular 管理设备后再次连接。
zh-CN.gatewayUnavailable: 网关 或其 Popular 后端不可用，客户端将重试连接。
zh-CN.gatewayRejected: 网关 拒绝了请求，请在诊断日志查看协议错误。
zh-CN.sessionRevoked: 连接授权已撤销，请点击连接重新验证设备身份。
zh-CN.introduction: 代理器可以让你本地的下载工具可以接入 Popular Movie 中心
zh-CN.resetHint: 清除已保存的下载工具地址、用户名和密码？现有下载和任务关联将保留。
zh-CN.downloaderRequired: 请先连接本地下载工具。
zh-CN.gatewayExplanation: 网关用于连接 Popular Movie 中心，接收下载指令并回报任务状态；本地下载工具负责实际下载，文件保存在下载工具配置的目录中。
zh-CN.downloaderExplanation: 请保持 Agent 和下载工具运行。下载工具未启动、未开启 Web 访问，或地址、端口、访问权限配置不正确时，Agent 将无法添加任务或获取下载状态。
zh-CN.webAccessHelp: 如何开启 Web 访问？
zh-CN.webAccessInstructions: 请先启动下载工具，并在其设置中开启 Web UI／远程访问，再将访问地址、端口和凭据填写到 Agent 中。使用 NAS 时，还需允许 Agent 所在电脑访问。
zh-CN.webAccessDocs: 具体设置请参考官方文档：
zh-CN.documentationError: 无法打开官方文档，请复制链接地址到浏览器中访问。
zh-CN.queueNotSynced: 尚无队列快照。连接网关后将加载待处理任务。
zh-CN.queueStale: 当前为缓存快照，队列可能已在上次同步后发生变化。
zh-CN.queueEmpty: 此 Agent 暂无待处理任务。
zh-CN.queueLoadError: 无法更新队列，已保留上次快照。
zh-CN.queueReason_verifying: 正在核实不确定的执行结果
zh-CN.apiKeyHint: 需要 qBittorrent 5.2.0 或更新版本。在 qBittorrent 设置 → WebUI → API Key 中生成；此密钥与 Gateway Key 不同。
zh-CN.queueReason_torrent_daily_limit: 单个种子当日下载已达上限
zh-CN.queueLimitExplanation: {site} 提示该种子的当日下载次数已达上限，尚未提交给下载工具。
zh-CN.queueLimitPaused: 自动重试已暂停至下次尝试时间（冷却 24 小时）。
zh-CN.queueLimitDue: 冷却期已结束，等待 Popular 重新尝试。
zh-CN.queueExpiresBeforeRetry: 任务将在下次尝试前到期。
